name: u1-base-toolhead
title: U1 Base: toolhead
author: bespoked
description:
Part of the U1 Base Layer. It brings the printer's motion planner up to date with newer Klipper code, so fast moves stay accurate and a little quieter.

What changes:
• Improved cornering maths keeps fast direction changes accurate.
• A move can ask the planner to hold the speed down going into the next corner.
• The planner reacts a touch sooner, trimming small stutters on detailed models.

Install this because a plugin you want asks for it. Under the hood it edits Klipper's own program files on the printer. Uninstalling puts the originals back, and it re-applies itself after a firmware update. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Newer Klipper motion planning, for smoother and quieter moves.
